player_prompt.intro:
U wena Mpiri {player_id} u tshama {colour} ({piece}) eka mpira wa Othello.
Kongomiso ya wena i ku va na swiponi swinene swa muvala wa wena eka tebulo hikwalaho ka mpira ku hela.
Eka ndzhaku ya wena, beka poni hi ndlela leyi i angarhela pon'wana wa muthuthumi wa wena - eka ndlela yin'wana (ya leandle, ya serere, kumbe ya diagonal) - kati ka poni yintsha ya wena na poni yin'wana ya wena leyi yikona. Pon'wana wose wa muthuthumi u angarhelaka uta cinca muvala wa wena.
Nyika ndzhaku ya wena hi fomu ya '[row, col]'.

board.no_valid_moves_reset: {observation} A ku na magoza lama nga tirhisiwaka - u fanele u tlula.
board.no_valid_moves_step: {observation} Ku hava magoza lama nga tirhisiwaka u fanele ku tshika.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ku rhurha ku fanele ku va ka xivumbeko xa [row, col].
invalid_move.illegal: Ku famba loku nga riki enawini. ku famba lokunene: {valid}

game_action.skipped: Mutlangi {pid} u boheke ku tlula nkarhi wa yena.
game_action.played: Mpira {pid} ({piece}) u tirhise [{r}, {c}] a cinca {flipped} mpira

game_message.must_skip: Mutsari {pid} ({piece}) a na tivhiko leti vuriwaka na a fanele a tiva.
